title: MARPA
subtitle: Memory-Augmented Reasoning & Planning Assistant
short: Building a personal assistant from the ground up, exploring language models, architecture, and the role of memory.
overview: MARPA is a long-running personal software project focused on building an approachable, adaptable assistant.
It combines hands-on model experimentation with design questions about memory, usability, safety, and maintainable software architecture.
highlights: Training experiments and evolving transformer architecture
Emphasis on clear documentation and extensibility

title: Python workflow demos
subtitle: Turning repetitive work into repeatable tools
short: Reusable Python examples that clean up structured data and turn repetitive steps into documented processes.
overview: A set of practical demonstration projects exploring Python automation and clear handoffs.
The examples are fictional or synthetic demonstrations—not claims of client engagements.
highlights: Reusable scripts with clear inputs and outputs

title: Website refresh study
subtitle: Small changes, better everyday experiences
short: An example of improving an existing small-business website through cleaner structure and accessible visual design.
overview: This fictional before-and-after website study explores how modest changes can make a site clearer, easier to navigate, and more comfortable to use.
It is a portfolio demonstration, not a delivered commercial client project.
highlights: Responsive layouts and clearer information hierarchy

title: The Hearthstead prototype
subtitle: Building a digital village, one workshop at a time
short: An open-ended experiment in accessible professional visibility, shared resources, and independent opportunity.
overview: Hearthstead is an early-stage idea for a welcoming professional community where skills matter more than status.
The first milestone is a transparent, accessible static website that can grow to support additional workshops and projects.
highlights: Designed to grow without a premature membership backend
